description: This source file implements a function to reconstruct a buffer based on a source buffer and a delta, as part of a patching process within the Git version control system. It defines the core logic of applying a delta generated by diff-delta.c, handling buffer allocations, parsing delta commands, and ensuring data consistency.

methods.name: void * patch_delta(const void * src_buf,unsigned long src_size,const void * delta_buf,unsigned long delta_size,unsigned long * dst_size)
methods.description: Recreates a buffer from a source buffer and a delta buffer by applying patch instructions. It performs validation, parses delta commands, and constructs the resultant buffer, returning NULL on errors.
